_comment: Each tile is a region of Picotron's own file-browser screenshot, cropped at 1:1. verify.gs draws the same chrome at the same coordinates on a 480x270 framebuffer, so a tile can be compared where it sits with no alignment step. Chrome only: regions carrying list rows, title glyphs or the scrollbar are excluded, because the harness does not draw content and a mismatch there would mean nothing.
